description: This file implements the MPSCNNNeuronOp class and the MPSCNNNeuronOpDescriptor class, providing methods to instantiate different neuron types (hardSigmoid, relu, sigmoid, tanh) as MPSCNNNeuron objects configured for Metal Performance Shaders. It manages singleton instances of various neuron configurations, utilizing dispatch_once for thread-safe lazy initialization, and contains platform-specific conditional code for macOS and Catalyst targets.

classes.name: MPSCNNNeuronOp
classes.description: Provides class methods to retrieve singleton instances of different neuron objects (hardSigmoid, relu, sigmoid, tanh) configured for Metal Performance Shaders, with platform-specific initialization.

classes.name: MPSCNNNeuronOpDescriptor
classes.description: Defines class methods to create configured MPSNNNeuronDescriptor instances for various neuron types, used to configure neurons in Metal Performance Shaders.

methods.name: hardSigmoid
methods.description: Returns a singleton MPSCNNNeuron configured for Hard Sigmoid activation, platform-conditioned for macOS/Catalyst and iOS.

methods.name: relu
methods.description: Returns a singleton MPSCNNNeuron configured for ReLU activation, platform-conditioned.

methods.name: sigmoid
methods.description: Returns a singleton MPSCNNNeuron configured for Sigmoid activation.

methods.name: tanh
methods.description: Returns a singleton MPSCNNNeuron configured for Tanh activation.

methods.name: hardSigmoidDescriptor
methods.description: Returns a singleton MPSNNNeuronDescriptor configured for Hard Sigmoid, with platform-independent descriptor creation.

methods.name: reluDescriptor
methods.description: Returns a singleton MPSNNNeuronDescriptor configured for ReLU activation.

methods.name: sigmoidDescriptor
methods.description: Returns a singleton MPSNNNeuronDescriptor configured for Sigmoid activation.

methods.name: tanhDescriptor
methods.description: Returns a singleton MPSNNNeuronDescriptor configured for Tanh activation.
